question: The value of \[ \frac{1}{2-\dfrac{1}{2-\dfrac{1}{2-\frac12}}} \] is
solution:
Start with the innermost subtraction, since its value determines the next fraction. Working outward gives
\[
\begin{aligned}
2-\frac12&=\frac32,\\
2-\frac{1}{3/2}&=2-\frac23=\frac43,\\
2-\frac{1}{4/3}&=2-\frac34=\frac54.
\end{aligned}
\]
Each denominator is positive, so every reciprocal is defined. The requested value is therefore
\[
\frac{1}{5/4}=\boxed{\frac45},
\]
choice B.
